events.description: A blue bus (N.B.S.T.C.) collides with a dark sedan and an orange-covered truck on a bridge, causing the sedan to be pushed sideways and the bus to swerve violently; debris and dust are visible by frame f8.

After the initial collision, the blue bus continues to skid and lose control, striking the guardrail and generating a large cloud of dust and debris; multiple vehicles scatter, and the orange truck is displaced significantly.

A violent collision occurs on the bridge: a dark sedan is struck from the side or rear, causing it to spin and disintegrate, with debris and dust erupting. The vehicle is seen airborne and breaking apart across frames f0–f6.

At night in Hatibagan, a dark car enters the intersection at high speed, loses control, and collides violently with a stationary or slow-moving truck/trailer (visible at f14), resulting in a large dust/debris cloud and the car being thrown sideways (highlighted in f10–f12, impact visible in f14–f15).

A dark sedan enters the intersection at high speed, loses control, and spins violently, skidding across the road surface while emitting smoke or dust. The vehicle appears to be airborne or heavily tilted during the spin.

After the initial spin, the same dark sedan continues sliding down the road, collides with a stationary object (possibly a parked vehicle or roadside structure) on the left side, and comes to rest. Debris is visible upon impact.
A white vehicle (likely a motorcycle or small scooter) is struck by a large truck moving from left to right, causing it to be thrown sideways and slide across the wet road surface.

A large truck collides with a smaller vehicle (possibly a bus or van) at an intersection; the impact causes the smaller vehicle to rotate sharply and be pushed sideways, with visible motion blur indicating high-speed collision.
A truck collides with a three-wheeled vehicle (auto-rickshaw) at an intersection, causing the auto-rickshaw to be pushed sideways and emit sparks or debris upon impact.

A truck collides with a smaller vehicle (possibly an auto-rickshaw or small van) at an intersection, producing a bright flash and visible debris/sparks. The impact occurs within the red circle; the smaller vehicle is displaced violently.

At Girish Park Crossing, a motorcycle enters the intersection and appears to be struck by or collide with a white van moving from left to right. The motorcycle is thrown sideways and disappears from view after impact.
A red SUV collides with a motorcycle at an intersection, causing the motorcycle and rider to be thrown to the ground; the SUV then drives over the fallen rider and motorcycle.

events.description: A man in white shirt is seen being forcibly pulled or dragged by another individual alongside the moving red bus; he loses balance and falls to the ground near the bus's rear wheels while the bus continues forward.
The fallen person lies on the road directly in the path of the moving red bus; the bus’s rear wheels appear to make contact with or run over the individual as it proceeds forward.

After being run over, the person remains on the ground while the bus continues moving; a second individual (in dark clothing) approaches and appears to strike or kick the prone person before stepping back.
A group of bystanders converge near the incident; two individuals engage in a brief physical scuffle—pushing and grappling—near the yellow taxi and the bus’s rear, while others intervene or observe.

A yellow taxi collides with a red-and-white bus at an intersection; the impact causes the taxi to rotate and push against the bus's side, while a person near the point of impact is thrown or falls to the ground.

A person in white appears to be struck or pushed by the moving taxi during the collision, falling onto the road surface near the bus’s rear wheel; the individual remains on the ground as vehicles continue moving around them, indicating vulnerability and lack of immediate aid in the initial moments.
